references.text: Jesus heals Peter's mother-in-law in a similar way by taking her by the hand and lifting her up, and the fever leaves her.
Luke gives a parallel account where Jesus heals Peter's mother-in-law by standing over her, commanding the fever to leave her, after which she immediately gets up and serves them.
Jesus heals a paralyzed man at Bethesda by first speaking to him, then commanding the man to get up, take his mat, and walk, demonstrating Jesus' power over sickness.
